capabilities.complete_execution: At most one model-selected changed candidate, complete simulation, unchanged reach evaluation and sampled holding/profile feedback.
capabilities.local_comparison: Optional one paired local comparison, two solves, <=300 charged seconds, at a saved baseline update with effective horizon 0.01 s; select one changed positive weight. Existing previous-input cold seed and integration retained. Unavailable/inconclusive screening does not prohibit a justified complete experiment.

instructions: Read at least one prediction view and one motion or plans view. At most two successful reading turns; independent views can be batched. Then submit a concise initial report with 2-4 facts selected using fact_handles, competing hypotheses, explicit gaps and recommendations. Use the current fact_catalog; the host resolves selectors, report.source and recommendation configuration_scope. Recommendations may defer pending a check. Do not execute or select a numerical check in this phase. Availability gaps must use inventory IDs and not_displayed, not_read, queried, not_retained or retained_unavailable; identify needed information/capability and basis. Unlisted evidence uses source plus explicit basis. Full sampled backend q/qdot is retained, even though motion shows the final window. Raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions/scaling. Diagnose the new common baseline. Only terminal_tip_speed_weight and holding_tip_speed_weight may later change under the explicit control grant. A reasonable testable hypothesis is enough to justify bounded exploration; proof of the dominant cause is not required. No geometry or material changes. Availability status applies to the entire inventory entry unless you supply update_ids (controller updates) or time_range_s (sampled backend motion). For a partially read entry, use queried and describe missing coverage, or explicitly scope a not_read/not_displayed declaration to the unread subset.

capability_gaps: No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool. Full trajectories are not in every request.
Existing numerical checks use a projected GVS state and bounded horizon, not a full backend replay.
inventory.claim_policy: Use inventory plus your receipt ledger: not_displayed, not_read in this context, queried with stated coverage, not_retained, or retained_unavailable through a named capability. A sampled view or failed raw gzip read does not prove absence.

memory_policy.policy: Reconstruct system instructions plus structured state; no chronological conversation replay.
memory_policy.retention: Own accepted handoff products FIFO; oversized products retain reference only. Existing recent evidence pages and last four actions stay within their original host limits. Phase changes preserve these in the same context.
memory_policy.separation: single_context shares one memory across phases; dual_context keeps one per role and receives explicit current request/report/response/feedback handoffs.

request_content.question: For the baseline execution cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef: reach passed and the terminal position error (0.007642608585867386 m) is within the 0.01 m position tolerance, yet the sampled final holding window shows position error spanning 0.007642608585867386–0.05813810428573256 m and speed spanning 0.6351726092425104–1.5810152739742807 m/s against a 0.02 m/s limit (sampled holding position and speed both failed). Per-update computation also stands out: mean_update_s = 17.26331904856488 s versus a 0.01 s control period, with 35 deadline misses. What does the retained evidence establish about terminal reach, sampled holding-window position, sampled holding-window speed, and update computation for this run, and which of these relationships — including any that might connect holding-window position/speed behavior to update computation or to plan-selection/optimizer status — remain unestablished or not computable with the current tools? Keep any causal explanation open rather than presupposing a dominant cause.
scope: Retained-evidence reading and reporting only, scoped to execution cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef and its retained inventory (source.one_step_predictions, source.applied_tensions, source.saved_projected_states, source.plan_selection, source.solver_status, source.controller_horizon, source.force_limits, source.backend_motion).
Reporting terminal reach, sampled holding position/speed, and update-computation observations with their stated coverage (selected samples; not whole-trajectory ranges or causal evidence).
This request excludes production changes and any backend execution or closed-loop counterfactual replay.
No saved-state numerical prediction/braking or local_comparison work is authorized or requested here; comparisons are limited to associating already-retained samples and program-derived summaries.
stopping_conditions: Terminal reach, sampled holding-window position error, sampled holding-window speed, and update-computation observations are each reported with their coverage (selected samples vs whole trajectory) and their source references.
Each candidate relationship is labeled established-by-retained-evidence, not displayed/not retained, or not computable with the current tools, without asserting a dominant cause.
The request is closed once it is stated whether any position/speed-vs-computation or optimizer-status link is supported, unsupported, or not computable with retained evidence and allowed tools.
